---
title: "Grouped joint plot"
description: "Compare several locations with shared marginals."
date: 2026-01-11
categories: [jointplot, grouping]
---

```{python}
#| label: fig-jointplot-grouped
#| fig-alt: "Joint plot grouped by location"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import soundscapy as sspy

data = pd.read_csv("../../assets/DemoData.csv")

places = ["CamdenTown", "PancrasLock", "RegentsParkJapan", "RegentsParkFields"]

sspy.jointplot(
    data[data["LocationID"].isin(places)],
    title="Joint plot with grouping",
    hue="LocationID",
    density_type="simple",
    diagonal_lines=True,
)
plt.show()
```
